title: 第二章 再从头，多少美好不放手？

content_zh:
一言出口，楚阳却一下子愣住了！
我……分明看到了轻舞来迎接我，那熟悉的浅笑，那已经沁入骨髓的柔情……
可……这是怎么回事？
这眼前，是无限的山石，天际残阳如血，四周飘飘潇潇的紫竹，如同天边翻腾的紫霞，一波一波的在微风中荡漾起伏……
自己脚边，还有一团血迹。
头上剧烈疼痛传来，伸手一摸，满手殷红。
这山，这石，这场景，这伤，竟然是如此的熟悉！
这是哪里？
一个声音在自己耳边带着几乎要哭的声音道：“喂……你……你不要吓我，我我……我这么英俊潇洒的人，可不禁吓啊……”
楚阳心中一阵迷糊，心道，难道我真的还没死么？不过，这在我耳边叫的家伙是谁？可真够极品的，明明快要吓死了，居然还没忘了自恋……
似乎是见他没有反应，那人又叫了起来：“真的……没气了？呜……”这一声哭却如是拉响了火车汽笛，若是有人远远地听见，定会认为是有饿狼在‘嗷~~~’的嚎叫了一声。
声音悠长响亮，袅袅不绝。居然有隐隐的回声传来，只不过那回声却真的变成了‘嗷~~~~’……
真有才。楚阳心中道。他也听得出来，这声音的确是又害怕又悲伤，这却是做不了假的；但这声音……实在是让人不敢恭维。
似乎老天爷在造人的时候弄错了，把一副鸭子的嗓子按在了他的身上，而且还是公鸭子……
大抵在完成之后老天爷又觉得不对劲，于是做了一下补偿，将狼的嗓子也借了一半来……
这声音，似乎有些熟悉啊……这样的声音实在是太独一无二了！楚阳心中一个激灵，突然间多年前的记忆，涌进了脑海……
“只不过是练练棍法而已，你不至于就这样被我一棍敲回去了吧？”那声音颤抖着，显然是吓坏了：“……他们敲了你那么多棍都没事，为啥我敲你一棍你就赖上我了……这这……这他.妈忒不公平了！难道你看我长得英俊潇洒心生嫉妒，故意陷害我的嘛？”
楚阳无语了。
这是个啥人？居然还在抱怨，抱怨也就罢了，毕竟这种事谁也不愿意碰见不是？可就连抱怨，居然也没忘了夸他自己几句……
自恋到了这地步，已经是惊天地而泣鬼神了！

呻吟了一声，楚阳终于勉强睁开了眼睛。实在是躺不下去了，纵然楚阳是一代毒剑武尊，却也受不了这等声音。
这等带着些许嘶哑的公鸭子嗓子和饿了许久的狼的声带融合在一起的混合音……不要说是人，就连老虎……听久了也得崩溃……
“醒了醒了，哇哈哈，我就知道，你是被我的帅气惊呆了而不是晕倒了……”那声音继续肆虐楚阳的耳朵：“我就说么，为啥正好好的打着，你居然盯着我的脸就不放了……原来如此！”
楚阳皱皱眉，脑袋里还在翻江倒海的疼，轻声喝道：“闭嘴！”实在受不了了。你要再说两句，我就往自己心脏上再扎两剑算了。反正老子都死过一次的人了，还得受你这样恐怖声音的折磨，这还有天理么？连死都不让人清静……
这啥世道……
他的声音虽低，却充满了威严。那一股毒剑武尊的森森气度，无形中就散发了出去。那正在喋喋不休的家伙被他这短短的两个字之中蕴含的森严所慑，竟然一下子呆住，说不出话来。
楚阳猛地睁开眼睛，却觉得眼前阳光耀眼，刹那间眼前金星乱冒。只好又闭上了眼睛，然后再徐徐睁开……
呈现在他面前的，是一张人的脸。嗯，也就是那位一个劲的在夸他自己英俊潇洒的那位仁兄。没错，此地除了他和楚阳之外，再也没有第三个人。
但楚阳一见到他这副尊容，顿时心中涌起一股亲切，同时感觉到一阵啼笑皆非。对‘英俊潇洒’这个词居然用在这个人身上而感到由衷的‘暴敛天物’！
这张脸绝对不丑！
眼睛大大的，鼻子挺挺的，嘴巴小小的，眉毛也是两道剑眉。而且面容白皙，不胖不瘦。
但最离奇的地方就在于，他的眼睛虽然大也很有神，但两只眼睛之间的距离，却有些大了，一只眼睛几乎在左耳朵边上，另一只……跟右耳朵做邻居。

content_en:
As soon as he said this, Chu Yang was stunned!
I... clearly saw Qing Wu coming to greet me, that familiar smile, that tenderness that has penetrated into my bones...
But... what's going on?
In front of us are endless mountains and rocks, the setting sun in the sky is like blood, and the fluttering purple bamboos all around are like the purple clouds rolling in the sky, rippling in the breeze one by one...
There was a pool of blood next to his feet.
Severe pain came from my head. I stretched out my hand to touch it, and my hands were all red.
This mountain, this stone, this scene, this injury, are so familiar!
Where is this?
A voice almost cried in his ear: "Hey... you... don't scare me, I, I... I am such a handsome and unrestrained person, I can't help but be scared..."
Chu Yang felt confused for a while and thought to himself, am I really not dead yet? But who is this guy shouting in my ear? It’s really amazing. He was almost scared to death, but he still hasn’t forgotten his narcissism...
Seemingly seeing that he didn't respond, the man shouted again: "Really... out of breath? Woo..." This cry sounded like a train whistle. If someone heard it from a distance, they would think it was a hungry wolf howling "Ouch~~~".
The sound is long, loud, and endless. There was actually a faint echo coming, but the echo really turned into ‘Ouch~~~~’…
So talented. Chu Yang thought in his heart. He could also tell that the voice was indeed frightening and sad, but it couldn't be faked; but the voice... was really unflattering.
It seems that God made a mistake when creating man and put a duck's throat on him, and it was also a male duck...
Probably after the completion, God felt something was wrong, so he made some compensation and borrowed half of the wolf's throat...
This voice seems a bit familiar... Such a voice is so unique! Chu Yang felt excited, and suddenly memories from many years ago flooded into his mind...
"It's just a practice of stick skills. You won't be knocked back by me with a stick, right?" The voice trembled, obviously frightened: "...They hit you so many times with the stick and it's okay. Why do you rely on me when I hit you with a stick? This... this... this is so unfair! Are you jealous because you see me handsome and handsome, and deliberately framed me?"
Chu Yang was speechless.
Who is this person? You are still complaining, that’s all. After all, no one wants to encounter this kind of thing, right? But even when he complained, he didn't forget to praise himself...
The narcissism has reached this level, which makes the gods and gods cry!
Groaning, Chu Yang finally reluctantly opened his eyes. I really couldn't lie down anymore. Even though Chu Yang was a poisonous sword warrior, he couldn't stand the sound.
This mixed sound with a slightly hoarse male duck voice and the vocal cords of a hungry wolf... not to mention humans, even tigers... will collapse after listening to it for a long time...
"Wake up, wake up, hahaha, I knew you were stunned by my handsomeness instead of fainting..." The voice continued to wreak havoc on Chu Yang's ears: "I'm just telling you, why did you just stare at my face and not let go... That's it!"
Chu Yang frowned, his head was still in overwhelming pain, and he shouted softly: "Shut up!" He couldn't bear it anymore. If you say a few more words, I will stab myself in the heart two more times. Anyway, I have died once, and I still have to be tortured by such a terrifying voice like yours. Is this justified? Not even death can make people peaceful...
What kind of world is this...
Although his voice was low, it was full of authority. The sinister demeanor of the Poison Sword Martial Master radiated out invisibly. The guy who was chattering was so frightened by the seriousness contained in his two short words that he was stunned and speechless.
Chu Yang opened his eyes suddenly, but I felt that the sun was dazzling in front of my eyes, and stars were flying in front of my eyes in an instant. I had to close my eyes again, and then slowly opened them...
What appeared in front of him was a human face. Well, that's the guy who keeps praising himself for being handsome. That's right, apart from him and Chu Yang, there is no third person here.
But as soon as Chu Yang saw his venerable appearance, he suddenly felt a sense of kindness in his heart, and at the same time felt a sense of ridicule. The word 'handsome and handsome' was actually used on this person, and I felt sincerely 'excessive'!
This face is definitely not ugly!
The eyes are big, the nose is straight, the mouth is small, and the eyebrows are also two sword eyebrows. And her face is fair, neither fat nor thin.
But the most bizarre thing is that although his eyes are big and bright, the distance between the two eyes is a bit too big. One eye is almost next to the left ear, and the other... is next to the right ear.
